# thermal — Ghostty

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build.lua -- do not edit -->

Symlink all flavours into place (idempotent, re-run any time):

```
nvim -l scripts/install.lua
```

Or copy one by hand:

```
cp ghostty/thermal-smoky ~/.config/ghostty/themes/
```

Then in `~/.config/ghostty/config`:

```
theme = thermal-smoky
```

Available: `thermal-smoky`, `thermal-void`, `thermal-ash`

For a light/dark pair Ghostty accepts:

```
theme = light:thermal-ash,dark:thermal-void
```
